policy.primaryContinuity: Marvel Comics #1 (1939) is provisional; the 1961 and 1936 alternatives are retained.
policy.descriptions: The thirty owner descriptions are reproduced verbatim; source prose is not copied.
policy.evidenceGaps: Independent bibliography and the Wizard special classification remain unverified; its on-sale date is unknown. Five provider on-sale dates differ from the pinned issue pages, although their years agree; each provider date is the first day of the cover month.
